pillar_reactions.evidence: Volunteered a positive reaction and tied it to his own reasoning about why machines had failed him: 'at the gym on the machines, like I said, you're just working one small set of muscles and you really have more muscle groups that don't get work that way. So the overall working of every muscle would be great... I might be able to climb a tree after this and, you know, who knows, you know, I want to be an animal.'

Understood and agreed without questions: 'Yeah, yeah. Love it.' when asked whether a protocol rather than calorie counting would be sustainable, and 'Food's not a problem for me' on continuing it long-term. He had already independently moved to a protein-led diet and a 500-1000 calorie deficit.

The pillar he had asked for before it was presented and the one he named as decisive: 'The support, to get me into the habit... getting into the habit, building it all up, making sure you don't fall off. Yeah, making sure I'm learning from somebody who knows what they're doing so I don't injure myself.'

anchors.raw: I've already ordered some equipment for myself. I got some, I got a set of Indian clubs, I also went and got myself a kettlebell set... and I got myself a pull-up bar that should be coming today.
anchors.note: He had already spent money on this before the call, unprompted, which is a genuine intent signal. It also means the equipment objection that appears on other calls never arose here.

anchors.raw: I get paid every two weeks, and I usually end up having a couple hundred dollars that rides until the next paycheck, after I take care of all my expenses and everything.
anchors.note: Roughly $400-500 a month of surplus, zero savings after a house repair, and no credit cards at all. His own opening number was '$100 a month'. Against $6,000 this is not a negotiating position, it is a structural constraint, and it is the reason the financing route was never viable either.

unmet_demand.want: An entry point payable from a few hundred dollars a month with no credit facility and no lump sum
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The only cheaper product is Primal University, which he could not pay for on the call either because he was between paydays and does not use credit cards. Below Primal University there is nothing.

unmet_demand.want: Reassurance that the injury that sent him to the doctor will not recur once he starts loading kettlebells
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He raised it as his opening reason for being on the call and the rep answered with an outcome promise rather than a clinical one — 'that back is completely going to be okay and that stiffness is just completely gone'. Nothing in the process screens or clears him.
